description.en: The IP address that you want to specify in the policy.

description.zh:
服务器暴力破解拦截策略阻断IP的方向。
取值：
- **in** ：入方向 
- **out**： 出方向
description.en:
The traffic direction that you want to specify in the policy. Valid values:

*   **in**: inbound
*   **out**: outbound

description.zh:
防暴力破解IP的记录ID。
> 调用[DescribeBruteForceRecords](~~DescribeBruteForceRecords~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the IP address blocking policy.

> You can call the [DescribeBruteForceRecords](~~DescribeBruteForceRecords~~) operation to query the policy ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas disable-brute-force-record --id 114166 --uuid cbb9aa80-a8d1-443c-9ff0-2c36cd390000 --block-ip 8.210.XX.XX --port 0/0 --bound in --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
